description_en: Obtains a Security Token Service (STS) token to assume a Resource Access Management (RAM) role
description_zh: 通过调用AssumeRole接口，获取一个扮演RAM角色的临时身份凭证（STS Token）
kebab_example: aliyun sts assume-role --role-arn acs:ram::1234567890120000:role/adminrole --biz-role-session-name alice --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssumeRole

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the STS token. Unit: seconds.

Minimum value: 900. Maximum value: the value of the `MaxSessionDuration` parameter. Default value: 3600.

You can call the CreateRole or UpdateRole operation to configure the `MaxSessionDuration` parameter. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28710.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28712.html
parameters.help_zh:
Token有效期。单位：秒。

Token有效期最小值为900秒，最大值为要扮演角色的`MaxSessionDuration`时间。默认值为3600秒。

您可以通过CreateRole或UpdateRole设置角色最大会话时间`MaxSessionDuration`。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28710.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28712.html
parameters.name: duration_seconds

parameters.help_en:
The policy that specifies the permissions of the returned STS token. This allows you to implement more fine-grained access control.

If you specify this parameter, the permissions of the returned STS token are the intersection of the permissions defined in this policy and the permissions granted by the role's policy.
If you do not specify this parameter, the returned STS token has all the permissions of the RAM role.

The value must be 1 to 2,048 characters in length.

For more information about policy elements and sample policies, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93738.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210969.html
parameters.help_zh:
为STS Token额外添加的一个权限策略，进一步限制STS Token的权限。具体如下：

如果指定该权限策略，则STS Token最终的权限策略取RAM角色权限策略与该权限策略的交集。
如果不指定该权限策略，则STS Token最终的权限策略取RAM角色的权限策略。

长度为1~2048个字符。

关于权限策略元素和示例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93738.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210969.html
parameters.name: policy

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the RAM role.

The trusted entity of the RAM role is an Alibaba Cloud account. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93691.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28710.html.

Format: `acs:ram::<account_id>:role/<role_name>`.

You can view the ARNs of RAM roles by using the RAM console or by calling API operations.

For more information about how to view the ARN of a RAM role in the RAM console, see the "How do I view the ARN of a RAM role?" section of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39744.html topic.
For more information about how to view the ARN by calling operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28713.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28711.html
parameters.help_zh:
要扮演的RAM角色ARN。

该角色是可信实体为阿里云账号类型的RAM角色。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93691.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28710.html。

格式：`acs:ram::<account_id>:role/<role_name>` 。

您可以通过RAM控制台或API查看角色ARN。具体如下：

RAM控制台：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39744.html。
API：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28713.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28711.html
parameters.name: role_arn

parameters.help_en:
The name of the role session.

The value is user-defined. In most cases, you can set this parameter to the identity of the user who calls the operation. For example, you can specify a username. You can specify `RoleSessionName` to identify API callers that assume the same RAM role in ActionTrail logs. This allows you to track the users that perform the operations.

The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: `. @ - _`
parameters.help_zh:
角色会话名称。

该参数为用户自定义参数。通常设置为调用该API的用户身份，例如：用户名。在操作审计日志中，即使是同一个RAM角色执行的操作，也可以根据不同的`RoleSessionName`来区分实际操作者，以实现用户级别的访问审计。

长度为2~64个字符，可包含英文字母、数字和特殊字符`.@-_`
parameters.name: role_session_name

parameters.help_en:
The external ID of the RAM role.

The value of this parameter is provided by an external party and is used to prevent the confused deputy issue. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2361741.html.

The ID must be 2 to 1,224 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: `= , . @ : / - _`. The regular expression for this parameter is `[\w+=,.@:\/-]*`
parameters.help_zh:
角色外部ID。

该参数为外部提供的用于表示角色的参数信息，主要功能是防止混淆代理人问题。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2361741.html。

长度为2~1224个字符，可包含英文字母、数字和特殊字符`=,.@:/-_`。正则为：`[\w+=,.@:\/-]*`
parameters.name: external_id

parameters.help_en:
The source identity information.

When a user assumes a role, the source identity of the user can be specified as the initial identity of a session. The specified source identity persists throughout the role session and cannot be changed. This ensures operation traceability and security.

The value must be 2 to 64 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: `=,.@-_`. The regular expression for this parameter is `[\w+=,.@-]*`. The value cannot start with `acs:`, `aliyun:`, or `alibabacloud:`. These prefixes are internally used within Alibaba Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
源身份信息。

在扮演角色时，可以指定扮演者的源身份（SourceIdentity）作为会话的初始身份标识。 该源身份的值在持续扮演角色的链式会话中将一直存在，中途不可更改，可确保操作的可追溯性和安全性。

SourceIdentity 长度为 2～64 个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、以及特殊字符：`=,.@-_`。正则为：`[\w+=,.@-]*`。您不能使用以`acs:`、`aliyun:`、`alibabacloud:` 开头的值，这些前缀为阿里云内部使用
parameters.name: source_identity

AssumedRoleUser.description_en: The temporary identity that you use to assume the RAM role
AssumedRoleUser.description_zh: 角色扮演时的临时身份

Arn.description_en: The ARN of the temporary identity that you use to assume the RAM role

AssumedRoleId.description_en: The ID of the temporary identity that you use to assume the RAM role

Expiration.description_en: The time when the STS token expires. The time is displayed in UTC

SecurityToken.description_en:
The STS token.

Alibaba Cloud STS does not impose limits on the length of STS tokens. We recommend that you do not specify a maximum length for STS tokens
SecurityToken.description_zh:
安全令牌。
安全令牌的长度不固定，我们强烈建议您不要对安全令牌的最大长度做任何限制

SourceIdentity.description_en:
The source identity information.

When a user assumes a role, the source identity of the user can be specified as the initial identity of a session. The specified source identity persists throughout the role session and cannot be changed. This ensures operation traceability and security.

If the SourceIdentity parameter was not specified in the request, this field is omitted from the response
SourceIdentity.description_zh:
源身份信息。

在扮演角色时，可以指定扮演者的源身份（SourceIdentity）作为会话的初始身份标识。 该源身份的值在持续扮演角色的链式会话中将一直存在，中途不可更改，可确保操作的可追溯性和安全性。

如果没有设置源身份信息，则该字段不会返回
